title: Tiếng Anh du lịch
overview: 12 bài từ A1 đến B2 cho chuyến đi: sân bay, khách sạn, ăn uống, di chuyển, xử lý sự cố và trải nghiệm văn hóa.

lessons.title: Làm thủ tục tại sân bay
lessons.objective: Check-in, xuất trình hộ chiếu, gửi hành lý và hỏi cửa ra máy bay.
lessons.reading:
Agent: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?
Passenger: To Singapore.
Agent: Can I see your passport, please?
Passenger: Here you are.
Agent: Do you have any bags to check in?
Passenger: Yes, one suitcase.
Agent: Window or aisle seat?
Passenger: Window, please.
Agent: Here's your boarding pass. Your gate is B12. Boarding starts at 9:40.

vocabulary.example: Can I see your passport, please?
I have one bag to check in.

grammar.title: Câu hỏi Wh- cơ bản
grammar.explanation: What (gì), Where (ở đâu), When (khi nào), What time (mấy giờ), Which (cái nào). Cấu trúc: Wh- + trợ động từ + chủ ngữ + V: Where are you flying to?
examples: Where is gate B12?
What time does boarding start?
Which seat do you want?

pronunciation.tip: aisle đọc giống 'I'll' — chữ s không phát âm. Gate /geɪt/ nhớ bật âm /t/ cuối.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai làm thủ tục check-in: trả lời nhân viên (thầy/cô).
Hỏi đường đến cửa B12 và giờ lên máy bay.

questions.prompt: Where is the passenger flying to?
questions.explanation: 'To Singapore.'

questions.prompt: How many bags does the passenger check in?
questions.explanation: 'one suitcase'.

questions.prompt: What seat does the passenger choose?
questions.explanation: 'Window, please.'
'Boarding starts at 9:40.'
Wh- + is + chủ ngữ.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'd like an _____.
questions.explanation: “aisle seat” nghĩa là “ghế cạnh lối đi”. Câu đầy đủ: I'd like an aisle seat.
“check in” = làm thủ tục, ký gửi. Ví dụ: I have one bag to check in.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Can I see your _____, please?
questions.explanation: “passport” nghĩa là “hộ chiếu”. Câu đầy đủ: Can I see your passport, please?
“boarding pass” = thẻ lên máy bay. Ví dụ: Here's your boarding pass.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I have one bag to _____.
questions.explanation: “check in” nghĩa là “làm thủ tục, ký gửi”. Câu đầy đủ: I have one bag to check in.

lessons.title: Nhận phòng khách sạn
lessons.objective: Nhận phòng, hỏi giờ ăn sáng, Wi-Fi và các tiện ích.
lessons.reading:
Receptionist: Good evening. Welcome to the Sunrise Hotel.
Guest: Hi. I have a reservation. My name is Pham.
Receptionist: Yes, a double room for three nights. Here is your key card. Your room is 305, on the third floor.
Guest: What time is breakfast?
Receptionist: From 6:30 to 10 in the restaurant.
Guest: Is there Wi-Fi?
Receptionist: Yes, it's free. The password is on your key card.

grammar.title: Is there…? / Are there…?
grammar.explanation: Hỏi có hay không: Is there a pool? (số ít) / Are there any towels? (số nhiều). Trả lời: Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
examples: Is there a gym in the hotel?
Are there any restaurants nearby?
Yes, there is. It's on the first floor.

pronunciation.focus: Số phòng và số thứ tự
pronunciation.tip: 305 đọc 'three-oh-five'. third /θɜːd/ — đặt lưỡi giữa hai răng cho âm /θ/, không đọc thành 'tớt'.

speakingTasks: Nhận phòng với thầy/cô: nói tên, số đêm và hỏi 2 tiện ích.
Hỏi về giờ trả phòng (check-out).

questions.prompt: How many nights is the guest staying?
questions.explanation: 'for three nights'.
'on the third floor'.
'in the restaurant'.
'The password is on your key card.'
towels số nhiều → Are there any…?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What's the Wi-Fi _____?
questions.explanation: “password” nghĩa là “mật khẩu”. Câu đầy đủ: What's the Wi-Fi password?
“double room” = phòng giường đôi. Ví dụ: We'd like a double room.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Here is your _____.
questions.explanation: “key card” nghĩa là “thẻ từ mở phòng”. Câu đầy đủ: Here is your key card.
“breakfast” = bữa sáng. Ví dụ: Breakfast is from 6:30.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We'd like a _____.
questions.explanation: “double room” nghĩa là “phòng giường đôi”. Câu đầy đủ: We'd like a double room.

lessons.title: Mua vé và đi phương tiện công cộng
lessons.objective: Mua vé tàu/xe buýt, hỏi giờ, sân ga và giá vé.
lessons.reading:
Passenger: Hello. A ticket to Brighton, please.
Clerk: Single or return?
Passenger: Return, please. How much is it?
Clerk: Twenty-four pounds.
Passenger: What time is the next train?
Clerk: At 11:15, from platform 4.
Passenger: How long does it take?
Clerk: About an hour.

vocabulary.example: How long does it take to the airport?

grammar.title: How much / How long / What time
grammar.explanation: How much…? hỏi giá; How long does it take? hỏi thời gian di chuyển; What time…? hỏi giờ cụ thể.
examples: How much is a single ticket?
How long does it take by bus?
What time does the bus leave?

pronunciation.tip: return /rɪˈtɜːn/ — nhấn âm sau, nguyên âm 'ơ' dài. Twenty-four nhấn 'twen' và 'four'.

speakingTasks: Mua một vé khứ hồi và hỏi giờ tàu, sân ga.
Hỏi thầy/cô cách đi từ sân bay về trung tâm thành phố.

questions.prompt: What kind of ticket does the passenger buy?
questions.explanation: 'Return, please.'
'Twenty-four pounds.'

questions.prompt: Which platform does the train leave from?
questions.explanation: 'from platform 4'.
'About an hour.'

questions.prompt: Which question asks about the price?
questions.explanation: How much = bao nhiêu tiền.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: A _____ ticket, please.
questions.explanation: “single” nghĩa là “vé một chiều”. Câu đầy đủ: A single ticket, please.
“single” = vé một chiều. Ví dụ: A single ticket, please.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The train leaves from _____ 4.
questions.explanation: “platform” nghĩa là “sân ga”. Câu đầy đủ: The train leaves from platform 4.
“next train” = chuyến tàu tiếp theo. Ví dụ: When is the next train?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: A _____ to Brighton, please.
questions.explanation: “ticket” nghĩa là “vé”. Câu đầy đủ: A ticket to Brighton, please.

lessons.title: Gọi món và yêu cầu đặc biệt ở nhà hàng
lessons.objective: Đặt bàn, gọi món, nói về dị ứng/khẩu vị và thanh toán.
lessons.reading:
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
Customer: Yes. I'd like the grilled fish, please. Does it come with rice?
Waiter: It comes with potatoes, but you can have rice instead.
Customer: Rice, please. Also, I'm allergic to peanuts. Is there any in the sauce?
Waiter: No, there isn't, but I'll tell the chef.
Customer: Thank you. Could we have some water too?

vocabulary.example: The sauce is a bit spicy.

grammar.title: some / any với danh từ không đếm được
grammar.explanation: some dùng trong câu khẳng định và lời mời/xin (Could we have some water?). any dùng trong câu hỏi và phủ định (Is there any sugar? There isn't any).
examples: Could I have some bread?
Is there any milk in it?
There aren't any vegetarian options.

pronunciation.tip: chef /ʃef/ — từ gốc Pháp, chữ ch đọc /ʃ/ như 'sh'. fish /fɪʃ/ nhớ giữ âm cuối /ʃ/.

speakingTasks: Gọi món ăn và đổi một món kèm, nói về một món bạn không ăn được.
Thầy/cô là phục vụ — hỏi về món đặc biệt của nhà hàng.

questions.explanation: 'I'd like the grilled fish'.

questions.prompt: What does the fish usually come with?
questions.explanation: 'It comes with potatoes'.

questions.prompt: What is the customer allergic to?
questions.explanation: 'I'm allergic to peanuts.'

options: Could we have a water some?
questions.explanation: Lời xin dùng some.

options: Are there any peanuts in it?
Is there some peanuts in it?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi dùng any.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'll tell the _____.
questions.explanation: “chef” nghĩa là “đầu bếp”. Câu đầy đủ: I'll tell the chef.
“come with” = ăn kèm với. Ví dụ: The steak comes with salad.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The _____ is a bit spicy.
questions.explanation: “sauce” nghĩa là “nước sốt”. Câu đầy đủ: The sauce is a bit spicy.
“sauce” = nước sốt. Ví dụ: The sauce is a bit spicy.
“allergic to” nghĩa là “dị ứng với”. Câu đầy đủ: I'm allergic to peanuts.

lessons.title: Tham quan và hỏi thông tin du lịch
lessons.objective: Hỏi giờ mở cửa, giá vé tham quan, tour và gợi ý địa điểm.
lessons.reading:
Tourist: Excuse me, what time does the museum open?
Guide: It opens at nine and closes at five, but it's closed on Mondays.
Tourist: How much is the entrance fee?
Guide: Ten euros for adults and five for students.
Tourist: Are there any guided tours in English?
Guide: Yes, there's one at eleven. It lasts about ninety minutes.
Tourist: Great. What else would you recommend?
Guide: You should visit the old market. It's the most famous place in town.

vocabulary.example: The entrance fee is ten euros.
The museum is closed on Mondays.
It's the most famous place in town.

grammar.title: So sánh nhất: the -est / the most
grammar.explanation: Tính từ ngắn: the + -est (the oldest, the biggest). Tính từ dài: the most + adj (the most famous). Bất quy tắc: good → the best, bad → the worst.
examples: It's the oldest building in the city.
This is the most beautiful beach.
That was the best tour.

pronunciation.tip: museum /mjuːˈziːəm/ nhấn âm thứ hai. recommend /ˌrekəˈmend/ nhấn âm cuối.

speakingTasks: Hỏi thầy/cô thông tin về một điểm tham quan: giờ, giá, tour.
Giới thiệu nơi nổi tiếng nhất ở quê bạn với so sánh nhất.

questions.explanation: 'it's closed on Mondays'.

questions.prompt: How much is the ticket for a student?
questions.explanation: 'five for students'.

questions.prompt: How long is the guided tour?
questions.explanation: 'about ninety minutes'.
old → the oldest.
'You should visit the old market.'

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The tour _____s ninety minutes.
questions.explanation: “last” nghĩa là “kéo dài”. Câu đầy đủ: The tour lasts ninety minutes.
“entrance fee” = phí vào cửa. Ví dụ: The entrance fee is ten euros.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The museum is _____ on Mondays.
questions.explanation: “closed” nghĩa là “đóng cửa”. Câu đầy đủ: The museum is closed on Mondays.
“recommend” = giới thiệu, gợi ý. Ví dụ: What would you recommend?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What would you _____?
questions.explanation: “recommend” nghĩa là “giới thiệu, gợi ý”. Câu đầy đủ: What would you recommend?

lessons.title: Phàn nàn nhẹ nhàng ở khách sạn
lessons.objective: Báo sự cố phòng ở (điều hòa, nước nóng, tiếng ồn) và yêu cầu hỗ trợ.
lessons.reading:
Guest: Hello, this is room 512. I'm afraid there's a problem. The air conditioner isn't working, and the room is very hot.
Reception: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll send someone to check it right away.
Guest: Thank you. Also, there was no hot water this morning.
Reception: I apologise. If it isn't fixed in thirty minutes, we'll move you to another room.
Guest: That would be great. Thanks for your help.

vocabulary.definition: e rằng (mở đầu lời phàn nàn lịch sự)
vocabulary.example: I'm afraid the TV doesn't work.
We'll move you to another room.

grammar.title: will cho lời hứa và quyết định tức thì
grammar.explanation: Dùng will + V khi quyết định ngay lúc nói hoặc hứa hẹn: I'll send someone. Phủ định: won't.
examples: I'll call the technician now.
We'll bring you some towels.
Don't worry, it won't take long.

pronunciation.tip: I'll đọc liền /aɪl/. isn't có âm /nt/ cuối rất nhẹ — đừng bỏ, vì nó mang nghĩa phủ định.

speakingTasks: Gọi lễ tân báo 2 sự cố trong phòng và yêu cầu giải pháp.
Thầy/cô đưa giải pháp chưa ổn — bạn đề nghị cách khác.

questions.explanation: 'The air conditioner isn't working'.
'there was no hot water this morning'.

questions.prompt: What will the hotel do if it isn't fixed?
options: Move the guest to another room
questions.explanation: 'we'll move you to another room'.

options: I sent someone right away tomorrow.
I'm going to send someone, I decided yesterday.
questions.explanation: Quyết định tức thì: will.

questions.prompt: Which opening is the most polite complaint?
questions.explanation: 'I'm afraid…' mở đầu lịch sự.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The _____ isn't working.
questions.explanation: “air conditioner” nghĩa là “máy lạnh”. Câu đầy đủ: The air conditioner isn't working.

options: e rằng (mở đầu lời phàn nàn lịch sự)
questions.explanation: “hot water” = nước nóng. Ví dụ: There's no hot water.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'll send someone _____.
questions.explanation: “right away” nghĩa là “ngay lập tức”. Câu đầy đủ: I'll send someone right away.

options: e rằng (mở đầu lời phàn nàn lịch sự)
questions.explanation: “right away” = ngay lập tức. Ví dụ: I'll send someone right away.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We _____ for the problem.
questions.explanation: “apologise” nghĩa là “xin lỗi (trang trọng)”. Câu đầy đủ: We apologise for the problem.

lessons.title: Xử lý sự cố khi đi du lịch
lessons.objective: Báo mất đồ, chuyến bay bị hủy, và mô tả đồ vật bị thất lạc.
lessons.reading:
Passenger: Excuse me, my suitcase didn't arrive. I was on flight VN301 from Hanoi.
Staff: I'm sorry. Could you describe it?
Passenger: It's a medium-sized black suitcase with a red ribbon on the handle. It has my name tag on it.
Staff: Thank you. It may have been sent to another airport. We'll deliver it to your hotel as soon as it's found.
Passenger: Will I be compensated if I need to buy clothes?
Staff: Yes, keep your receipts and we'll reimburse reasonable expenses.

vocabulary.example: It has a red ribbon on the handle.
There's a name tag on it.
We'll deliver it to your hotel.

grammar.title: Câu bị động thì tương lai và may have been
grammar.explanation: Bị động tương lai: will be + V3 (It will be delivered). Phỏng đoán quá khứ: may/might have been + V3 (It may have been sent to another airport).
examples: Your bag will be delivered tonight.
The flight may have been delayed by the storm.
You will be compensated for the delay.

pronunciation.focus: Mô tả đồ vật: thứ tự tính từ
pronunciation.tip: Kích cỡ → màu → chất liệu: a medium-sized black leather suitcase. Nhấn các tính từ quan trọng khi mô tả.

speakingTasks: Báo mất hành lý: mô tả va li chi tiết và hỏi về bồi thường.
Thầy/cô hỏi thêm thông tin — trả lời rõ ràng.

questions.explanation: 'my suitcase didn't arrive'.

options: Medium-sized black suitcase with a red ribbon
questions.explanation: 'medium-sized black suitcase with a red ribbon'.

questions.prompt: Where will the suitcase be delivered?
questions.explanation: 'deliver it to your hotel'.
will be + V3.
'keep your receipts'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Could you _____ your bag?
questions.explanation: “describe” nghĩa là “mô tả”. Câu đầy đủ: Could you describe your bag?
“reimburse” = hoàn trả chi phí. Ví dụ: We'll reimburse your expenses.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: It has a red _____ on the handle.
questions.explanation: “ribbon” nghĩa là “dải ruy băng”. Câu đầy đủ: It has a red ribbon on the handle.
“describe” = mô tả. Ví dụ: Could you describe your bag?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Will I be _____d?
questions.explanation: “compensate” nghĩa là “bồi thường”. Câu đầy đủ: Will I be compensated?

lessons.title: Thuê xe và lái xe ở nước ngoài
lessons.objective: Thuê xe, hỏi về bảo hiểm, nhiên liệu và luật giao thông.
lessons.reading:
Agent: Have you booked a car with us?
Customer: Yes, a compact car for five days.
Agent: Would you like full insurance? It covers any damage to the car.
Customer: How much extra is it?
Agent: Fifteen dollars a day. The car has a full tank, and you have to return it full.
Customer: Do I need an international driving permit?
Agent: Yes, you do. And remember, we drive on the left here.

vocabulary.example: I've booked a car for five days.
The car has a full tank.
You need an international driving permit.
In the UK, people drive on the left.

grammar.title: have to / must / don't have to
grammar.explanation: have to và must: bắt buộc (You have to return it full). don't have to: không bắt buộc (You don't have to pay now). mustn't: cấm (You mustn't smoke in the car).
examples: You have to show your licence.
You don't have to pay a deposit.
You mustn't park here.

pronunciation.tip: mustn't — chữ t đầu câm: /ˈmʌsnt/. Nói rõ để tránh nhầm nghĩa 'phải' với 'cấm'.

speakingTasks: Thuê một chiếc xe: hỏi giá, bảo hiểm và các quy định.
Giải thích cho thầy/cô 3 quy định giao thông ở Việt Nam với have to / mustn't.

questions.prompt: How long does the customer need the car?
questions.explanation: 'for five days'.
'Fifteen dollars a day.'

questions.prompt: How must the car be returned?
questions.explanation: 'you have to return it full'.

questions.prompt: “You don't have to pay now” means…
questions.explanation: don't have to = không bắt buộc.

questions.prompt: Which side do they drive on?
questions.explanation: 'we drive on the left here'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The car has a _____.
questions.explanation: “full tank” nghĩa là “đầy bình xăng”. Câu đầy đủ: The car has a full tank.
“full tank” = đầy bình xăng. Ví dụ: The car has a full tank.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Full _____ covers all damage.
questions.explanation: “insurance” nghĩa là “bảo hiểm”. Câu đầy đủ: Full insurance covers all damage.
“cover” = chi trả, bao gồm. Ví dụ: It covers any damage.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: In the UK, people _____.
questions.explanation: “drive on the left” nghĩa là “lái bên trái”. Câu đầy đủ: In the UK, people drive on the left.

lessons.title: Trò chuyện với người địa phương
lessons.objective: Bắt chuyện, hỏi về văn hóa, ẩm thực địa phương và chia sẻ về đất nước mình.
lessons.reading:
Local: Is this your first time in Japan?
Traveller: Yes, it is! I've been here for three days. Everything is so clean and organised.
Local: Have you tried any local food yet?
Traveller: I've tried ramen, but I haven't tried okonomiyaki. What is it exactly?
Local: It's a kind of savoury pancake. You should try it in Osaka.
Traveller: I will. By the way, in Vietnam we have something similar called bánh xèo.

vocabulary.example: Is this your first time here?
By the way, where are you from?

grammar.title: Hiện tại hoàn thành với for / since
grammar.explanation: for + khoảng thời gian (for three days), since + mốc thời gian (since Monday). Dùng cho việc bắt đầu trong quá khứ và còn tiếp diễn.
examples: I've been here for three days.
She has lived in Osaka since 2020.
How long have you been in Japan?

pronunciation.focus: Giới thiệu từ tiếng Việt cho người nước ngoài
pronunciation.tip: Khi nói tên món Việt, nói chậm và giải thích ngay: 'bánh xèo — it's a crispy pancake'. Nhấn 'kind of' nhẹ.

speakingTasks: Bắt chuyện với thầy/cô như người địa phương, hỏi về món ăn và lễ hội.
Giới thiệu một món ăn Việt Nam và so sánh với món nước ngoài.

questions.prompt: How long has the traveller been in Japan?
questions.explanation: 'I've been here for three days.'

questions.prompt: What has the traveller already tried?
questions.explanation: 'I've tried ramen'.
'a kind of savoury pancake'.

options: I've been here for three days.
I've been here since three days.
I'm here for three days ago.
questions.explanation: for + khoảng thời gian.
By the way = nhân tiện, chuyển ý.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, where are you from?
questions.explanation: “by the way” nghĩa là “nhân tiện”. Câu đầy đủ: By the way, where are you from?
“a kind of” = một loại. Ví dụ: It's a kind of pancake.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I prefer _____ snacks.
questions.explanation: “savoury” nghĩa là “mặn (không ngọt)”. Câu đầy đủ: I prefer savoury snacks.
“first time” = lần đầu. Ví dụ: Is this your first time here?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I love trying _____.
questions.explanation: “local food” nghĩa là “món ăn địa phương”. Câu đầy đủ: I love trying local food.

lessons.title: Lên kế hoạch chuyến đi dài ngày
lessons.objective: Thảo luận lịch trình, ngân sách và lựa chọn bằng câu điều kiện và động từ khuyết thiếu.
lessons.reading: We're planning a two-week trip around Vietnam. If we fly into Hanoi, we could spend three days in the capital before heading to Ha Long Bay. Alternatively, we might start in the south and work our way north. The main issue is the budget: domestic flights are quick but pricier, whereas sleeper trains are cheaper and more scenic. Whichever route we choose, we'll need to book accommodation in Hoi An well in advance, as it gets crowded during festivals.

vocabulary.example: Then we'll head to Ha Long Bay.
Alternatively, we could take the train.
We'll start in Saigon and work our way north.
The train ride is very scenic.
Book your hotel well in advance.

grammar.title: Động từ khuyết thiếu chỉ khả năng: could / might / may
grammar.explanation: could/might/may + V diễn tả khả năng, lựa chọn chưa chắc chắn. Kết hợp với 'whereas' để so sánh đối lập và 'whichever' (bất cứ … nào).
examples: We might take the night train.
Flights are faster, whereas buses are cheaper.
Whichever hotel you choose, book early.

pronunciation.focus: Nói câu dài với nhịp đều
pronunciation.tip: Chia cụm: 'If we fly into Hanoi, / we could spend three days / in the capital / before heading to Ha Long Bay.'

speakingTasks: Lên lịch trình 1 tuần cho người nước ngoài đến Việt Nam, giải thích lựa chọn.
Thầy/cô có ngân sách thấp — điều chỉnh kế hoạch.

questions.prompt: How long is the planned trip?
questions.explanation: 'a two-week trip'.
'The main issue is the budget'.
'cheaper and more scenic'.
'as it gets crowded during festivals'.
whereas = trong khi đó (đối lập).

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, we could take the train.
questions.explanation: “alternatively” nghĩa là “hoặc là (phương án khác)”. Câu đầy đủ: Alternatively, we could take the train.
“well in advance” = rất sớm, từ trước. Ví dụ: Book your hotel well in advance.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The train ride is very _____.
questions.explanation: “scenic” nghĩa là “có phong cảnh đẹp”. Câu đầy đủ: The train ride is very scenic.
“pricier” = đắt hơn. Ví dụ: Flights are pricier than trains.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Book your hotel _____.
questions.explanation: “well in advance” nghĩa là “rất sớm, từ trước”. Câu đầy đủ: Book your hotel well in advance.

lessons.title: Khiếu nại dịch vụ và đòi bồi thường
lessons.objective: Khiếu nại chuyến bay trễ/tour kém chất lượng, lập luận và thương lượng bồi thường.
lessons.reading:
Customer: I booked a tour that promised a private boat and a seafood lunch. Instead, we were put on a crowded boat with forty people, and lunch was a sandwich. Had I known this, I wouldn't have booked with you.
Manager: I'm very sorry. The private boat was unavailable due to a mechanical fault.
Customer: I understand that things go wrong, but nobody informed us. I'd expect at least a partial refund.
Manager: That's fair. We can refund fifty percent, or offer you a free tour of your choice.

vocabulary.example: The website promised a private boat.
Nobody informed us about the change.

grammar.title: Đảo ngữ điều kiện: Had I known…
grammar.explanation: Thay cho If I had known…, văn phong trang trọng dùng đảo ngữ: Had I known, I wouldn't have booked. Tương tự: Were I you… (= If I were you), Should you need… (= If you need).
examples: Had I known, I would have chosen another company.
Should you need help, please call us.
Were it not for the delay, we'd be there now.

pronunciation.focus: Giữ giọng chắc chắn nhưng lịch sự
pronunciation.tip: Nhấn sự thật: 'NObody inFORMED us'. Lên giọng nhẹ khi đưa yêu cầu để tránh gay gắt.

speakingTasks: Khiếu nại một dịch vụ du lịch kém: mô tả, lập luận, đề nghị bồi thường.
Thầy/cô từ chối lần đầu — thương lượng tiếp.

options: A private boat and a seafood lunch
questions.explanation: 'promised a private boat and a seafood lunch'.

questions.prompt: Why was the private boat unavailable?
questions.explanation: 'due to a mechanical fault'.

questions.prompt: What is the customer's main complaint besides the service?
questions.explanation: 'nobody informed us'.
Đảo ngữ của điều kiện loại 3.
'refund fifty percent, or offer you a free tour'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The boat was very _____.
questions.explanation: “crowded” nghĩa là “đông đúc”. Câu đầy đủ: The boat was very crowded.
“mechanical fault” = lỗi kỹ thuật (máy móc). Ví dụ: There was a mechanical fault.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The website _____d a private boat.
questions.explanation: “promise” nghĩa là “hứa hẹn, cam kết”. Câu đầy đủ: The website promised a private boat.
“promise” = hứa hẹn, cam kết. Ví dụ: The website promised a private boat.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The room was _____.
questions.explanation: “unavailable” nghĩa là “không có sẵn”. Câu đầy đủ: The room was unavailable.

lessons.title: Du lịch bền vững và văn hóa
lessons.objective: Thảo luận tác động của du lịch, du lịch có trách nhiệm và tôn trọng văn hóa.
lessons.reading: Mass tourism can bring economic benefits to local communities, but it also puts pressure on fragile environments and can lead to overcrowding. Responsible travellers try to minimise their footprint: they choose locally owned accommodation, respect cultural customs, and avoid single-use plastics. Some destinations have introduced visitor caps, which, despite being unpopular with tour operators, have helped protect heritage sites.

vocabulary.example: Overcrowding is a problem in summer.
Try to reduce your carbon footprint.
Hoi An is a heritage site.

grammar.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định và despite
grammar.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ sung thông tin, có dấu phẩy và không dùng 'that': Visitor caps, which are unpopular, help protect sites. despite + danh từ/V-ing (despite being unpopular).
examples: Hoi An, which is a heritage site, gets crowded.
Despite the rain, we enjoyed the tour.
The guide, who was very friendly, spoke three languages.

pronunciation.tip: reSPONsible, enviRONment, HERitage, OVERcrowding. Từ dài nói sai trọng âm rất khó hiểu.

speakingTasks: Nêu quan điểm: có nên giới hạn số khách đến một điểm du lịch nổi tiếng?
Đề xuất 3 cách để du lịch có trách nhiệm hơn ở Việt Nam.

questions.prompt: What is one negative effect of mass tourism?
questions.explanation: 'can lead to overcrowding'.

questions.prompt: Which is a habit of responsible travellers?
questions.explanation: 'choose locally owned accommodation'.
'introduced visitor caps'.

options: Despite of the rain, we went.
questions.explanation: despite + danh từ, không có 'of'.

options: Hoi An which is beautiful, is busy.
Hoi An, that is beautiful, is busy.
Hoi An, which is beautiful, is busy.
questions.explanation: Không dùng 'that'; có hai dấu phẩy.
“customs” nghĩa là “phong tục”. Câu đầy đủ: Respect local customs.
“customs” = phong tục. Ví dụ: Respect local customs.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Hoi An is a _____.
questions.explanation: “heritage site” nghĩa là “di sản”. Câu đầy đủ: Hoi An is a heritage site.
“overcrowding” = tình trạng quá tải. Ví dụ: Overcrowding is a problem in summer.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ is a problem in summer.
questions.explanation: “overcrowding” nghĩa là “tình trạng quá tải”. Câu đầy đủ: Overcrowding is a problem in summer.
